say:1:1421907001:1.text: Magister, hello again! It's been a lucky day for us. See what we've found!
say:1:1421907001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，又遇到你了！今天可真是幸运！看看我们发现了什么！
say:1:1421907001:1.male: Magister, hello again! It's been a lucky day for us. See what we've found!
say:1:1421907001:1.female: Magister, hello again! It's been a lucky day for us. See what we've found!

say:3:1421907002:1.text: Found what, you thieves? This stele belongs to my ancestor! Wait a minute, you guys know each other?
say:3:1421907002:1.source_cn: 发现了什么？你们两个小贼发现的是俺先祖留下的遗迹！不对...

say:4:1421907003:1.text: Are you two in league with this envoy?!
say:4:1421907003:1.source_cn: 难道你们和这个特使……是一伙的？！
say:4:1421907003:1.male: Are you two in league with this envoy?!
say:4:1421907003:1.female: Are you two in league with this envoy?!

say:6:1421907004:1.text: Oh, Drew! Can you just relax a little? There must be some misunderstanding here, right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:6:1421907004:1.source_cn: 哎呀德鲁，别疑神疑鬼的，肯定是有误会嘛，你说是不是？<...
say:6:1421907004:1.male: Oh, Drew! Can you just relax a little? There must be some misunderstanding here, right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:6:1421907004:1.female: Oh, Drew! Can you just relax a little? There must be some misunderstanding here, right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:7:1421907005:1.text: If you as an envoy, don't deal with these petty thieves, I, Drew Ironheart, will take matters into my own hands!
say:7:1421907005:1.source_cn: 你这个特使要是不处理这两个小贼，俺德鲁·铁心就亲自动手！
say:7:1421907005:1.male: If you as an envoy, don't deal with these petty thieves, I, Drew Ironheart, will take matters into my own hands!
say:7:1421907005:1.female: If you as an envoy, don't deal with these petty thieves, I, Drew Ironheart, will take matters into my own hands!

say:9:1421907006:1.text: Hey, slow your roll! Why does everyone always see us as thieves? Is there any job more dangerous than archaeology?
say:9:1421907006:1.source_cn: 等等！我们怎么又被当成贼了！还有比考古更高危的职业吗！

say:10:1421907007:1.text: We're archaeologists from the Evergreen Conservatory, here to study the ruins of the Ironheart Dominion. We came across this stele and would like to conduct further research...
say:10:1421907007:1.source_cn: 我们是冬青学会的考古学家，在这里考察钢心帝国的遗迹，发...

choice_prompt:11:1421907007.text: We're archaeologists from the Evergreen Conservatory, here to study the ruins of the Ironheart Dominion. We came across this stele and would like to conduct further research...
choice_prompt:11:1421907007.source_cn: 我们是冬青学会的考古学家，在这里考察钢心帝国的遗迹，发现了这块遗迹石碑，想做进一步的考察……

say:12:1421907008:1.text: Archaeologists... Conservatory... Drew Ironheart can't make heads or tails of what you're saying! Anyway, this is a stele from my ancestor, not something for you to be messing with!
say:12:1421907008:1.source_cn: 考察……协会……这些俺德鲁·铁心听不懂，但这是俺矮人先...

say:13:1421907009:1.text: Trust us, we're genuinely interested in the Ironheart Dominion! An empire ruled by gods and dragons, the pinnacle of dwarven civilization, and the mystery behind its sudden collapse—it's truly captivating!
say:13:1421907009:1.source_cn: 当然是因为我们对钢心帝国感兴趣！神明与龙共治的帝国、极...

say:14:1421907010:1.text: Since this stele belongs to your ancestor, you must know that it details an important ritual from the Ironheart Dominion, right? It's an invaluable historical artifact!
say:14:1421907010:1.source_cn: 既然这是你先祖留下的遗迹，你应该知道这石碑上记载着钢心...

say:15:1421907011:1.text: Ritual... Artifact... What does that even mean? Are you saying this stele is a sturdy, durable material?
say:15:1421907011:1.source_cn: ……祭礼……史料……这又是什么意思？是说这石碑是什么结...

say:17:1421907012:1.text: Are you telling me you don't understand the meaning of these inscriptions?
say:17:1421907012:1.source_cn: 你该不会不知道石碑上文字的意思吧？

say:18:1421907013:1.source_cn: 怎、怎么可能不知道！这上面不就写着……

say:19:1421907014:1.text: Alright, I don't understand a thing! I can't read, so what?
say:19:1421907014:1.source_cn: 好吧，俺确实不知道！俺不认字，那又怎么了嘛！

say:20:1421907015:1.text: Aren't you curious about what they mean?
say:20:1421907015:1.source_cn: 你不好奇这上面写的字是什么意思吗？

say:21:1421907016:1.source_cn: 你这么说，我是有点好奇……

say:23:1421907017:1.text: Our job is to share the meaning of these inscriptions and the history they represent with the public. We're not here to steal anything!
say:23:1421907017:1.source_cn: 我们考古学家的工作就是让更多知道这些文字的含义和文字背...

say:24:1421907018:1.text: O—Okay, you're making my head spin here. Just don't take or damage the stele!
say:24:1421907018:1.source_cn: 好、好吧，越说俺的脑子越昏了，总之你们别把俺先祖的石碑...

say:25:1421907019:1.text: I'm glad the air is cleared! This is a chance for you to learn more about your ancestor, Drew! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come take a look. These inscriptions might hold a deeper meaning...
say:25:1421907019:1.source_cn: 误会解开就好！刚好德鲁你也能趁这次机会了解更多先祖的事...
